rows: A reflection in the booth monitor shows Nisha at the workstation while the export progress bar is visible. The monitor’s filename field reads “Comet_Final_v7.mp4”. The photo cannot show the source filename or prove intent, but it places Nisha at the active export session.

The short playback file’s final frame contains a rehearsal-only note: “Reveal animation still pending — do not use for judging.” The same wording appears in the rehearsal cut’s project notes. The submitted 2-minute file’s preview frame, preserved at upload, contains the finished reveal instead.

A draft in Nisha’s handwriting reads: “If Comet misses reveal, hold scoring; Orbit can take the spare slot. Use the short render if timing gets tight.” It is timestamped 3:47 PM, two minutes before the short export. The note must be read with the export log and her presence at the workstation.

The kiosk archive still holds Dev’s 2-minute file with checksum 91C4. The playback copy has checksum 7A20 and matches the 42-second rehearsal cut. The original was not corrupted or overwritten; a different export was placed in the playback package.
